Ava (Docs): FYI I opened a tiny PR to clarify an edge case in the Dedicated docs about batching and KV cache cold starts. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345
Ravi (Eng): Nice, will take a look. Quick ask — the Python SDK snippet still uses `max_batch` in one spot, should be `batch_limit` now.
Ava (Docs): ugh good catch, that slipped past me. I'll update the snippet and add a note about behavior when KV cache is cold (first few requests hit higher latency).
Marta (SRE): Also noticed a copy-paste typo in the autoscale policy table header: "min_replics" -> should be "min_replicas". Might confuse folks using the terraform example.
Keegan (Infra): We should call out the on-prem/private nuance too: small Dedicated pools + conservative batch_limit recommended because egress/network jitter can amplify latency.
Ava (Docs): Agreed, I'll add a short callout under "Batching best practices" for Private + VPC setups.
docs-bot: PR #2345 opened by Ava (Docs) against docs/main — checks running
Jenna (Docs Ops): Quick question — since this touches an SDK snippet, do we want an automated smoke test before merge? It's docs-only but runnable.
Ravi (Eng): Docs-only is fine to merge once the param name is corrected, but file an issue to add the snippet to the docs-smoke CI job later.
Ava (Docs): Filed issue #412 to track adding the SDK snippet to smoke tests. Updated the snippet in the PR. New snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# updated parameter name
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-alpha', prompt='Hello', batch_limit=8)
print(resp.text)
```
Marta (SRE): That looks runnable. Suggest a brief callout after the snippet: "May observe higher first-request latency due to KV cache warmup".
Ava (Docs): Added the warmup callout and a link to the runtime caching doc. Also fixed the "min_replicas" typo in the autoscale table.
Keegan (Infra): Thanks — updated the on-prem note to mention conservative limits and a sample terraform var: `default_batch_limit = 4` for small GPU pools.
Jenna (Docs Ops): LGTM from docs-ops side. I'll merge once checks finish and slot for Tuesday deploy.
Ava (Docs): Thanks everyone! Merged after CI passed :tada:
docs-bot: PR #2345 merged into docs/main by Ava (Docs)
Ravi (Eng): Thanks — can we add a follow-up to show an example where batching improves cost at 128-token seqs? Not necessary to block this fix.
Ava (Docs): Will add a short example in a follow-up PR. Closing thread here. Thanks :seedling:
